annotations.title: Tie out CAM reconciliations against another system's results

description: Reconcile FactLot's CAM reconciliation for one expense pool with another system's per-tenant results (Yardi or any other; parity is not claimed and is untested against a real export): give the calc_cam_reconciliation_batch input plus, per tenant, what the other system reported (share, gross-up, cap limit and reduction, admin fee, base-year or stop deduction, billed amount, estimates, balance; billed_amount required) and a tolerance. Returns per tenant and line FactLot's amount, the other amount, the difference and whether it is within tolerance, tenants missing on either side, and likely causes worded as hypotheses to check: a different pro rata share (and, when every share differs by one factor, the pool's denominator), or a FactLot rerun that matches the other system with lines left to the default controllable: true set uncontrollable, the cap's base year one year off, the other cap method, the other gross-up target or no gross-up, the admin fee before or after and within or outside the cap, or no fee on uncontrollable lines; and differing estimates paid. Deterministic: the same inputs always give the same result, with formula ID calc.reconcile_cam@1, every step, and any warnings.

cam.description: The FactLot CAM input for one expense pool, exactly as calc_cam_reconciliation_batch takes it (the same pool, shares and lease terms you entered in the other system).

expenses.description: The building's operating expense pool for the year, entered once for every tenant: category, amount, controllable, recoverable, variable, admin_fee_applies.

admin_fee_applies.description: Included in the admin_fee base. Set false for lines the lease excludes from the fee (often taxes, insurance, utilities, or a management fee already charged).

amount.description: Building-level actual expense for the year, USD.

category.description: Expense line as named in the operating statement, e.g. "janitorial".

controllable.description: Subject to the cap. Taxes, insurance, and utilities are typically uncontrollable. Default true; under a cap, lines left unset are named in warnings.

recoverable.description: Excluded expenses (capital items, landlord-only costs) are dropped entirely.

variable.description: Varies with occupancy, so eligible for gross-up (janitorial, utilities, management fee). Default false; with a gross-up, lines left unset are named in warnings.

gross_up.description: Gross up variable expenses to the target occupancy when actual occupancy is lower. Omit if the lease has no gross-up.

actual_occupancy.description: Average occupancy for the year, e.g. 0.82. Must be greater than 0.

target_occupancy.description: Gross-up occupancy stated in the lease (commonly 0.95 or 1.0). Must be greater than 0.

tenants.description: Every tenant to reconcile (up to 500): each one's share, structure (base year or stop), cap, admin fee, occupancy, estimates paid, and lease-specific exclusions. Each statement equals calc_cam_reconciliation for that tenant.

admin_fee.description: Administrative fee the lease adds to the tenant's share. Omit if the lease has none.

applied.description: Fee on controllable lines computed on the tenant's share before the cap (before_cap) or on the capped amount (after_cap). Fees on uncontrollable lines are never capped. Irrelevant without a cap.

capped.description: True when the fee on controllable lines counts toward the controllable cap (controllable share plus fee may not exceed the cap limit); false adds it outside the cap.

rate.description: Administrative or management fee as a decimal of the fee base, e.g. 0.15 for 15%. The base is the tenant's share of recoverable lines with admin_fee_applies (after gross-up). Must be greater than -1. Must be less than 10.

admin_fee_excluded_categories.description: Expense categories this tenant's lease keeps out of the admin fee base, treated as admin_fee_applies: false for this tenant only. Each must match a category in expenses.

cap.description: Cap on the tenant's share of controllable expenses. Omit if the lease has no cap.

method.description: compounding_from_base: reference × (1+rate)^years (often called cumulative, compounding). simple_from_base: reference × (1 + rate × years) (cumulative, non-compounding). year_over_year: prior year's capped amount × (1+rate) (non-cumulative). Map the lease language to one of these explicitly.

rate.description: Annual cap as a decimal, e.g. 0.05. Must be greater than -1. Must be less than 10.

reference_amount.description: Tenant's share of controllable expenses in the reference year: the base year for *_from_base, or the prior year's capped amount for year_over_year, USD.

years_elapsed.description: Years since the base year (required for `*_from_base`).

estimates_paid.description: Estimated CAM payments the tenant made during the year, USD (total for the year, not monthly).

excluded_categories.description: Expense categories this tenant's lease excludes, treated as recoverable: false for this tenant only. Each must match a category in expenses.

name.description: Tenant or suite label, unique, e.g. "Suite 200 – Acme".

occupancy.description: Partial-year occupancy: the tenant's share, cap limit, and base-year or stop deduction are prorated by occupied days ÷ period days (both inclusive), so a full-year cap and base are not applied to a part year. Omit for a full year.

move_in_date.description: Date the tenant's share starts within the reconciliation period, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive). Defaults to period_start_date.

move_out_date.description: Last day of the tenant's share within the period, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive). Defaults to period_end_date.

period_end_date.description: Last day of the reconciliation period, YYYY-MM-DD (at most 366 days after the start). Defaults to December 31 of year.

period_start_date.description: First day of the reconciliation period, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to January 1 of year; set it for a lease year.

pro_rata_share.description: Tenant's pro rata share, 0 < share ≤ 1 (e.g. 12,000 / 150,000 = 0.08). Must be greater than 0.

structure.description: Expense structure from the lease. Default: net.

oneOf.description: Tenant pays its full share of recoverable expenses (NNN / net).
Tenant pays its share of the excess over base-year expenses.

base_year_expenses.description: Total building recoverable expenses in the base year, already grossed up, USD.

oneOf.description: Tenant pays its share of the excess over a fixed expense stop.

stop_amount.description: Building-level expense stop, USD per year.

year.description: Calendar or lease year being reconciled.

other.description: What the other system reported for the same pool and year.

pool.description: The pool these results are for, e.g. "CAM", echoed in the result.

system.description: Name of the system or file the results come from, echoed in the result, e.g. "Yardi CAM recon export" (free text).

tenants.description: The other system's per-tenant results for this pool. Give whatever it reports; billed_amount is required.

admin_fee.description: The other system's admin or management fee for the tenant, USD.

admin_fee_applied.description: Whether the other system charged an admin fee.

balance_due.description: The other system's balance due (negative for a credit), USD.

billed_amount.description: What the other system billed the tenant for the year before estimates (FactLot's tenant_charge), USD.

cap_applied.description: Whether a cap reduced the other system's charge.

cap_limit.description: The other system's cap limit on the tenant's controllable share, USD.

cap_reduction.description: Amount the cap removed in the other system, USD.

estimates_paid.description: Estimates (prior billings) the other system credits for the year, USD.

gross_up_applied.description: Whether the other system grossed up variable expenses for this tenant.

grossed_up_expenses.description: The other system's pool after gross-up (the building amount before the tenant's share), USD.

pool.description: The other system's expense pool for this row, e.g. "CAM" (echoed; reconcile one pool per call).

pro_rata_share.description: The other system's pro rata share for the tenant, 0 < share ≤ 1. Must be greater than 0.

structure_deduction.description: The other system's base-year or expense-stop deduction, USD.

tenant.description: Tenant as the other system names it; matched to cam.tenants[].name exactly, else ignoring case and punctuation.

tolerance.description: When two amounts agree: |FactLot − other| ≤ max(absolute, relative × |other|); shares within share. Default: 1.00 USD, 0, and 0.000001.

absolute.description: Largest difference, USD, still counted as agreeing (default 1.00).

relative.description: Largest difference as a share of the other system's amount still counted as agreeing, e.g. 0.0001; the larger of the two tolerances applies (default 0). Must be less than 1.

share.description: Largest pro rata share difference still counted as agreeing (default 0.000001). Must be less than 1.
